note: NFR-TST-03 invariant 1: the resolve cache key covers every output-affecting setting. Every key of the settings inventory (Core/Settings/Domain/SettingsDefaults.cpp, or the AppSettings accessors while that table is not on the tree) is classified here: output with the Shared/Playback StreamRequest field it sets, or not output with a reason. Every StreamRequest field is classified too, and every cache key implementation listed under cache_keys must cover each output field, or declare it applied by the host after the shared answer. Checked by tools/platform_check.py cache_key; rationale in docs/PLATFORM_CHECKS.md.

speculative.reason: prefetch hint: the work may be dropped, the answer is the same

signedIn.reason: RES-20: the primary resolve never uses the account; the session always sends false, so the answer is the same

network.reason: label of the network class the ceiling was chosen for; the ceiling itself is maxHeight

host_applied.highFrameRate: the pinned component has no frame-rate field and ranks every rung (higher fps first within a height); the SailTube host must drop or demote >30 fps rungs after the shared answer, so one cached answer serves both values
host_applied.videoCodecs: the pinned component only knows hardwareDecode (H.264 first); the SailTube host must order video codecs (Automatic/H.264/VP9) after the shared answer
host_applied.poProvider: the pinned component's client needs no PO token; the provider only affects the yt-dlp fallback, which the host keys in StreamSource.h cacheKey() (playback to confirm)
host_applied.clientOverride: diagnostics-only client choice for the yt-dlp fallback; the shared component uses its pinned client (playback to confirm)

playback/maxHeightMobile.reason: the ceiling of the current network class is what the request carries

playback/adaptivePipeline.reason: player side: Off makes the player use the muxed list of the same StreamSet; the contract has no field for it, and it applies at start-up only

providers/poProvider.reason: RES-08/RES-14: a PO-token provider changes which formats the extractor returns

providers/clientOverride.reason: RES-10: the provider client changes the answer

providers/extractorChannel.reason: chooses which extractor build runs; the formats a video offers do not depend on it, so a cached answer stays valid

playback/resume.reason: start position, applied by the player

playback/speed.reason: playback rate, applied by the player

audio/loudness.reason: uses StreamSet.loudnessDb, which every answer carries

downloads/folder.reason: downloads resolve on their own runner, never through the playback resolve cache (RES-02)

downloads/quality.reason: downloads resolve on their own runner, never through the playback resolve cache (RES-02)

playback/stableVolume.reason: host-side audio choice from the same answer

playback/coverVideo.reason: cover rendering of the same frames

diagnostics/startLowRung.reason: start-up experiment: the first plan uses a lower rung of the same StreamSet, then one switch up; the resolve answer is the same

providers/poTokenHeapMb.reason: V8 heap ceiling of the PO-token helper; does not change which formats are returned
